text:
maria (People Ops): dropping a compact pack for the upcoming self-review window — focused on short, usable artifacts: 2-line impact bullets, a 5-line self-review body, an evidence checklist, and a 3-min manager prep script. putting this here for quick feedback before I add to the handbook. cc @simon @devin

ops-bot: reminder — Self-review window opens Mon 4/4. Submit by 11:59pm PT. Link: https://handbook/self-review

simon (Eng): love the idea. can we include a tiny "what I looked at" signals list (metrics, PRs, customer convo links)? that's what helps calibration.

maria (People Ops): yes — good call. added a single-line evidence checklist below. full pack (copy / paste into docs):

```
TWO-SENTENCE IMPACT BULLET (use for header)
- Change: one concise sentence describing what you shipped or influenced (feature, process, doc, support flow)
- Outcome: one concise sentence with the measurable or observable result (metric lift, time saved, customer quote, reduced incidents)

5-LINE SELF-REVIEW BODY (aim for <= 5 lines)
1) Headline (2-sentence impact bullet as above)
2) What I did (1 short line; scope & contribution)
3) Why it mattered (1 short line; customer/team/business impact)
4) Evidence (1 line: metrics/PRs/tickets/demos)
5) Next steps / blockers (1 line)

EVIDENCE CHECKLIST (single line for reviewers)
- Metrics: dashboard link(s); PRs: #; Tickets: # or short link; Demo / recording: link (if applicable)

MANAGER 3-MIN PREP SCRIPT (use before calibration / 1:1)
- Quick summary: repeat the 2-line impact bullet
- Signals I saw: list metrics, PRs, customer notes, peer feedback (1-2 items)
- Suggested rating & one-line rationale (raise / keep / lower)
- Any calibration asks? (yes/no + 1-line rationale)

STAR-LITE EXAMPLE
- Change: cleaned up onboarding flow; added automated checks for missing env vars
- Outcome: reduced support tickets by ~18% and shortened average time-to-first-success by 2 days
- Evidence: dashboard: /d/123/onboarding; PRs: 412, 419; demo recorded: link
```

aj (Product): quick nit — prefer Outcome start with the measurable result (so Result then short note about user impact). otherwise looks very usable.

maria (People Ops): ok switching to "Change → Result" order as default. also added a one-line manager rubric: "raise/keep/lower + 1-line evidence" for calibration speed.

devin (Manager): this will save so much time in calibration. can we add a tiny template for cross-functional feedback (1 sentence: impact on product / infra / biz)?

maria (People Ops): adding that now — final line added to the pack: "Cross-func note: 1-liner on who else was impacted and how." planning to drop the file in /handbook/self-review/self-review-snappack.md and ping the team Monday morning.

simon (Eng): :thumbsup: thanks — excited to try this in our 1:1s.
